name: portfolio-experience
blurb: Professional experience timeline with fade-in animations, metrics, and tech stacks.
description: Full-section component displaying SaaS career highlights. Each role shows company, position, location, metrics (ARR, uptime, users), tech stack, and narrative description. Items fade in as they scroll into view. Hard-coded content.
use_when: Portfolio pages showcasing professional background with emphasis on metrics and tech skills.
avoid_when: Reusable experience components; data is baked in.
a11y: Semantic section and header elements. Text hierarchy with h2/h3. Scroll-triggered animations render all text visible.
